title: Applications of flexible materials in health management assisted by machine learning
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22386-22410

In this paper, flexible materials, machine learning mechanisms and flexible wearable devices made by integrating machine learning algorithms are reviewed, providing a new idea for the application of flexible materials in clinical medicine.
